calls.title: Logan / Kari
calls.summary: The team discussed refining the onboarding process to reduce user overwhelm and enhance clarity, emphasizing its importance in user engagement. Kari Kay and Logan Bates highlighted the complexity faced by users during initial setup, advocating for a tailored approach based on user roles. Dashboard customization was identified as crucial, though prioritized features are currently limited. The experiment creation flow was presented with simplified interfaces that progressively reveal options to users. Feedback management challenges were noted due to a lack of dedicated product management, increasing team workload. Sales commitments influencing product features post-acquisition were also discussed, with a need for sustaining quality and consistency in design amid evolving team dynamics.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, Metrics Library, Onboarding, Dashboard Design, Product Analytics, Design System
calls.action_items:
**Logan Bates**
Set up a test account for Kari Kay to demonstrate dashboard widget creation and drag-and-drop interface (10:00)
Share names and contact info of former Statsig designers with Kari Kay for further insights into their design team and structure (19:45)

**Kari Kay**
Continue enhancing and updating GrowthBook’s create experiment flow, focusing on reducing user friction and improving onboarding (22:34)

**Kari Kay and Logan Bates**
Remain available for ongoing questions and knowledge sharing about experimentation and product design best practices (28:50)
